mintAuthority.summary: StandX DUSD has native issuance on BSC and Solana. BSC's sole MINTER_ROLE is held by the Settler controller proxy under a 3-of-4 DEFAULT_ADMIN Safe, while Solana mint authority is a Settler-program PDA whose program upgrade authority is separately reviewed. The issuer Gateway, Highway, vault, and off-chain settlement controls are assessed under Bridge Risk; the terminal Settler/RSV backend signer set is issuer-undisclosed and remains the manual-review cap on this profile.

controls.label: StandX Solana Settler program mint authority PDA
controls.evidence: At finalized slot 439738655 (2026-08-16), the DUSD Solana mint DUSDt4AeLZHWYmcXnVGYdgAzjtzU5mXUVnTMdnSzAttM (Token-2022) has mintAuthority and freezeAuthority H4Mp7WL282pdbY9V9N7AJnsQwB5yyrU1E7svfsH2Ur5h, a PDA owned by the StandX Settler program STANDKqqZERMKosYH2PAtNtnt6mig4CRPycsRwjuVhB. The program's current upgrade authority is recorded separately below; the prior observation that it was immutable is stale.

controls.label: StandX Solana Settler program upgrade authority
controls.evidence: At finalized slot 439738658 (2026-08-16), Settler program data 4XNF9sPKbX3SAor8mm8HDbWycw7qGC642NJs6mePqXQe reported upgrade authority 8BRbk69F5dnPrxvnnWMhmWVyqECWnGcYDfMT8G96JzBh. The authority account is system-owned and non-executable, but it can replace the mint-critical Settler program logic.

controls.label: StandX BSC Settler (sole MINTER_ROLE)
controls.evidence: 2026-07-20: a full RoleGranted/RoleRevoked log scan of the BSC DUSD token from deployment (block 47,000,000) through block 111,600,000 confirms MINTER_ROLE was granted to this Settler controller proxy at block 47,451,545 and revoked from the deployer in the same transaction — it is the only MINTER_ROLE holder that has ever existed. StandX separately documents Gateway 0x00b4f9b510893505acefb10ec91cbc972185088e as the deposit and redemption component, while 0x2c02f575cdd0cc87de89ae6a493b05a5ed95065a is Settler. 2026-07-20 follow-up (BSC block 111,123,001+, bsc-dataseed.binance.org): the Settler proxy is a 130-byte ERC-1822/UUPS delegating proxy that loads its implementation from the non-ERC1967 slot 0x827d913d90d0c987a6f064bb327aef37980afaf247de25f9b07747de0af89dd1 (currently 0xdf09ebf9a24080deedb0a9a85db0b3aa9a90caa1); both ERC-1967 slots on the proxy read zero, and the implementation's proxiableUUID() returns that same custom slot with UPGRADE_INTERFACE_VERSION() = "5.0.0" (OpenZeppelin Contracts v5 UUPSUpgradeable). The Settler proxy carries its own AccessControl: hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x6c2404092cb1acfe9a06bc7de61bf619933edba5) = true and hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x649b82c8de192e92f8dc9c88f63038016ce56310) = false. At BSC block 116363031, the pinned MINTER_ROLE read remained positive for Settler and negative for the BSC Safe and Gateway address.

controls.label: StandX BSC DEFAULT_ADMIN Safe (3-of-4)

sources.label: BSC public RPC (upgradeToAndCall authorization probe + hasRole reads, 2026-08-16)

controls.evidence: 2026-07-20: the previously unresolved 171-byte DEFAULT_ADMIN contract is a Gnosis Safe 1.1.1 proxy (masterCopy() = 0x29fcB43b46531BcA003ddC8FCB67FFE91900C762) with owners 0x222542fac5d6f5c2562312f907d202be807ee415, 0x955703b14f475bc0c53db9522283ba1bf1c8a8e1, 0x649b82c8de192e92f8dc9c88f63038016ce56310, and 0x56383a4af4482a708dbbac53bf03ad706028b203, threshold 3. The full role-event scan confirms DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE was granted to this Safe at block 48,266,832 and revoked from the deployer, with no later role events. 2026-07-20 follow-up: this same Safe controls the Settler/Gateway mint path. A simulated eth_call of upgradeToAndCall(0xdf09ebf9a24080deedb0a9a85db0b3aa9a90caa1, "") against the Settler proxy succeeds from this Safe and reverts from every other tested sender with the OpenZeppelin v5 error AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount(address,bytes32) (selector 0xe2517d3f) naming upgrade role 0x189ab7a9244df0848122154315af71fe140f3db0fe014031783b0946b8c9d2e3. Direct reads confirm hasRole(0x189ab7a9..., Safe) = true and hasRole(0x189ab7a9..., deployer EOA 0x649b82c8...) = false, and getRoleAdmin(0x189ab7a9...) = DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, which the Safe also holds. At BSC block 116363031 the Safe still held DUSD DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and the custom mint-logic upgrade role; the DUSD token proxy's current custom implementation slot resolved to 0x2e8749ea4b3324376fa740f63abba2993d1ffdb2 at block 116364053.

controls.label: StandX Settler / backend + RSV Fund multisig
controls.evidence: The Settler manages delta-neutral positions across CEXes and the RSV Fund multisig bridges assets between on-chain and off-chain platforms; StandX can reject redemption orders, making the issuer backend a controlling party over the mint/redeem lifecycle.

review.evidence: StandX operates native DUSD issuance on BSC and Solana through the Gateway/Settler and Token-2022 Settler paths, with the off-chain Settler/RSV backend still participating in mint and redemption. At finalized Solana slot 439738655 (2026-08-16), the DUSD mint has mintAuthority and freezeAuthority H4Mp7WL282pdbY9V9N7AJnsQwB5yyrU1E7svfsH2Ur5h, a PDA owned by Settler program STANDKqqZERMKosYH2PAtNtnt6mig4CRPycsRwjuVhB; at slot 439738658, program data 4XNF9sPKbX3SAor8mm8HDbWycw7qGC642NJs6mePqXQe reports upgrade authority 8BRbk69F5dnPrxvnnWMhmWVyqECWnGcYDfMT8G96JzBh, so the former immutable-program statement is stale. At BSC block 116363031, Settler 0x2c02f575cdd0cc87de89ae6a493b05a5ed95065a remains the sole MINTER_ROLE holder; the official Gateway is 0x00b4f9b510893505aceFB10eC91cBC972185088e, and the 3-of-4 Safe 0x6c2404092cb1acfe9a06bc7de61bf619933edba5 controls DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and the custom mint-logic upgrade role. The BSC token proxy implementation was 0x2e8749ea4b3324376fa740f63abba2993d1ffdb2 at block 116364053, while Settler and Gateway resolve to 0xdf09ebf9a24080deedb0a9a85db0b3aa9a90caa1 and 0xb69f4f80ec472ff9fe86933ac739329f8f72dc3b respectively. The backend signer set remains issuer-undisclosed; no dated whole-supply reconciliation covers BSC, Solana, and off-chain positions, so economic cap semantics remain unbounded, reconciliation unknown, supervision none, and confidence manual-review.
